issue_context.title: WebApplicationBuilder should register the developer exception page in the pipeline by default for Development environment
comments:
Hardcoding environment checks in the runtime has been an ongoing complaint for people that define their own environments. https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/28937.

The standing recommendation is for there to be an intermediate option people can set to control runtime behaviors, but it could default to IsDevelopment.

In this specific example the workaround isn't bad, they can call UseDeveloperExceptionPage themselves, but they'll also have to call UseRouting to fix the ordering which is a discoverability issue. Is this change intended to work around https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/34146?
This isn't related to the `UseRouting` issue as that pertains to `UseExceptionHandler` not `UseDeveloperExceptionPage`
